text: でんわ　してるんだ！

structure.jp: でんわ　してるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. Here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. でんわ　してる = 'am phoning'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the feeling of explaining your situation. してるんだ = 'the thing is, I'm doing it'.
